title: Which Anti-Aging Senolytic Supplement Should You Avoid?
abstract: A senolytic compound and anti-cancer drug called ABT-263 accelerates ovarian aging in aged mice, suggesting it promotes infertility. * The senolytic ABT-263 reduces structures in the ovaries called follicles, which may lead to infertility in older mice. However, Chinese scientists have recently discovered that a senolytic compound called ABT-263 accelerates ovarian aging in female mice. ## Senolytic ABT-263 Accelerates Ovary Aging. Moreover, the ABT-263-treated aged mice had even less follicles than the untreated aged mice. (Xia et al., 2024) **ABT-263 Senolytic Reduces Ovarian Follicles.** Compared to young (Y) mice, old (O) mice have fewer follicles (No. of primordial follicles). Furthermore, some ovaries in the ABT-263-treated mice had blood clots and ruptures, suggesting that ABT-263 damages the ovaries of aged mice. (Xia et al., 2024) **ABT-263 Senolytic Shrinks Ovaries.** Compared to young (Y) mice, the ovaries of old (O) mice are smaller, as shown. ABT-263 targets ovarian cancer, suggesting this senolytic may affect the ovaries more than others. The senolytic drug ABT-263 accelerates ovarian aging in older female mice.
